name: Census
summary: Self-hosted Telegram money agent that reads bank spends via open banking and answers questions from a small SQLite ledger.
description: A private Telegram money agent for UK/EU open-banking banks. It reads your bank through TrueLayer, keeps a small SQLite ledger, treats repeating charges as subscriptions, and answers spend, save-target and leftover questions in short replies via an OpenRouter model that can call tools. Self-hosted, one process, built to run on Railway with a volume; needs a Telegram bot token, an OpenRouter key, a TrueLayer app and an allowlist of Telegram user ids. Runs locally on Bun 1.4+.
contains: private Telegram bot that reads bank transactions through TrueLayer open banking
